finding: First run with no save: Play skips the load screen and opens a New Game card (name max 20, 3 classes with one-line descriptions, Randomize, permadeath checkbox). Read in src/GameStateTitle.cpp:307-313 and src/GameStateNew.cpp:85-90.

Opening is a diegetic tutor: a dead-body NPC with a 7-line tour, movement locked (allow_movement=false), on a 2x2 trigger at 19,19 on Arrival. Eight backstory caption cards play on load first. Trigger may fire on the first frame because the start tile 20,20 is inside it; order vs cutscene not run. Files: flare-game maps/arrival.txt:154-178, npcs/tutorial.txt.

First fight is three spaced level-1 zombies on River Trail (category=zombie, level=1, at 4,21 / 46,5 / 54,7), picked at random from a category by the engine. Winnability not computed (hero stats not read). flare-game maps/river_trail.txt:284-298.
Level-up is a log line (Congratulations, reached level N), an attribute hint line, then sound; the Character button is flagged for attention. src/Avatar.cpp:522-535, src/GameStatePlay.cpp:665-667.

Hub Perdition Harbor: two vendors whose stock is gated by status and level. Unlock events at levels 5, 9, 13 set status flags that add stock rows (perdition_harbor.txt:284-309). Waypoint found by walking a 6x6 area with a one-line message. Quest 0000 is 16 status-gated steps; campaign totals 60 steps across 13 quest files.
Death penalty default is 50 percent of currency, no XP loss by default (mods/default/engine/death_penalty.txt:7-8). Ambient: four looping environment sounds placed as events on Arrival.

Best transferable idea: tutor as a dead body with a note, movement lock for three to seven lines, first fight as spaced single enemies, vendor stock that changes at set levels. Look test: phone first swing under 30 s with at most three lines read. Licence: engine GPL v3 (shape only); campaign data CC-BY-SA 3.0 blanket, audio class C.

Boot runs an intro stage then a random pick of two menu backdrops; a typewritten story screen runs unless skipintro or quick-start is set. Skip is three presses on Back (MainMenu.cpp:3471-3480), each text box pauses fpsLimit x 5. Data (data/story/intro.json) is not in the box.

Once-only first-run offer: "Barony is a challenging game. Would you like to play a tutorial?" Yes opens the Hall of Trials (tutorial1); No shows a note pointing to the Play Game menu (MainMenu.cpp:23652-23690, prompt call at 26614). The on-screen window in mod_tools.cpp:375 is dead code (returns on its first line).

Hall of Trials: ten trial maps in the manifest (files.cpp:1787-1796); trial titles and descriptions come from data/tutorial_strings.json (not in box). Completion shows a count: "9 more trials are available" (lang/en.txt:5829). Strong visible next goal.

Starter kit is hand-coded per class in initClass (charclass.cpp:693 on, 40 class checks); barbarian's iron axe goes straight into hotbar slot 0 (charclass.cpp:759). Class card shows per-stat colour words and class list is filtered by content-pack validity (MainMenu.cpp:13543, 16651). 26 class values (game.hpp:137-162).

Best transferable idea: a ten-trial hub with a visible N-more count after each win, first trial one enemy, ramp to three attackers across the ladder (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3). Licence: code BSD 2-Clause; data pack absent and README needs a purchased copy, so category-level only. Not read: first fight, hamlet map, monsters' placement, hit feedback beyond one helper.
